text: A pizza is cut into 8 slices and you eat 3 of them. How many slices are left?
If today is Monday, what day will it be three days from now?
Unscramble NEDLON to find a capital city.
Counting only the small squares, how many squares are there on a chessboard?
An octopus and a spider meet on the seabed. How many legs do they have between them?
why: An octopus has 8 arms or legs and a spider has 8 legs: 8 + 8 = 16.

text: A family's dog has six puppies. They give two away, then she has three more. How many puppies do they have now?
How many minutes pass between quarter to ten and quarter past eleven?
why: 9:45 to 10:45 is 60 minutes, then 30 more to 11:15.

text: Rearrange the letters of TEAM to make something you might eat.
A £20 shirt has 25% knocked off in a sale. What does it cost now?
Kate is 8 and her brother is twice her age. When Kate turns 16, how old will her brother be?
why: He's 16 now, 8 years older; in 8 years he'll be 24, not double her age.

text: Spot the pattern in the gaps: 3, 6, 11, 18, 27. Which number follows?
why: The gaps go up by odd numbers, 3, 5, 7, 9, so the next gap is 11: 27 + 11 = 38.

text: Which word goes in front of BALL, PRINT and PATH to make three new words?
Four brothers each have exactly one sister. How many children are in the family?
why: They all share the same sister: 4 boys + 1 girl = 5.

text: Take ten per cent of 10,000, then ten per cent of that. What are you left with?
Draw a six-pointed star as two overlapping triangles. Counting big and small, how many triangles can you see?
why: The two big triangles plus the six small points: 2 + 6 = 8.

text: Add these in your head: 1,000 + 40 + 1,000 + 30 + 1,000 + 20 + 1,000 + 10. What's the total?
why: Four thousands make 4,000 and 40 + 30 + 20 + 10 = 100: 4,100. Many say 5,000.

text: A board is four tiles wide and four tiles tall. Counting every square you can make from whole tiles, big and small, how many are there?
There's only one even prime number. What is it?
why: Every other even number divides by 2, so only 2 itself is prime.

text: Lily pads on a pond double in area every day, and the pond is fully covered on day 30. On which day was it half covered?
why: It doubles overnight, so half covered is just one day earlier.
